faq.q: Can I change the look, the voice, or the language?
faq.a: Yes. Pick from 53 actors and choose a voice or language that fits your audience. You can reuse the same presenter across ads.

faq.q: Are AI actors good for product explainers?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can explain product features clearly and consistently. Update the message in minutes without booking another shoot.

faq.q: How can brands use AI actors for social media?
faq.a: Keep one AI actor across a series of social posts and change the opening each time. You can make more versions without filming again.

faq.q: How do AI actors make videos?
faq.a: Type your message, choose an actor and voice, and generate a video. The actor speaks the words with matching lip movement, ready for you to review.

faq.q: Can I update training videos with an AI actor?
faq.a: Yes. Change the message and make a new training video. You can keep lessons current without bringing a presenter back to a studio.
It is a realistic digital presenter for your video. Choose its look and voice to explain your product without filming a person.

faq.q: Where can I use AI actors?
faq.a: Use an AI actor in product ads, website videos, social posts, and short explainers. You can keep the same presenter across channels.

faq.q: Can I use AI actors commercially?
faq.a: Yes. AI actor videos have no watermark and can be used commercially. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600.

faq.q: What should I know before using an AI actor?
faq.a: Tell viewers when a presenter is AI if the platform requires it. Do not impersonate a real customer or use someone’s face or voice without permission.

reviews.h2: How Shops Put an AI Actor to Work
reviews.lead: Each shop picks one actor, gives them one product point, and posts the clip themselves.
